audit.whatIsWrong: All 7 phases[N].side read the generic 'Skill' while content win[] says Karma for rows 0-5 and Lulu for row 6. phases[6].why ('Late Karma enables...') also describes KARMA winning while win[6]='Lulu'.
audit.why: The chart renders no verdict at all (Skill != either name) while the sentence under row 6 flatly contradicts the recorded winner.
audit.corrected: Set side to Karma for rows 0-5 and Lulu for row 6 to match win[]. Rewrote phases[6].why to explain Lulu's real late-game edge (Whimsy + Wild Growth as a single-target peel kit), grounded in the same reasoning already in content.whys[6]/spikes[3].text. Rows 0-5 kept their existing why text since it already described Karma's poke lead.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Gathering Fire haste' (whys[3], mid) is not a Karma ability — her only passive is Mantra cooldown reduction from damaging abilities, not a haste grant.
audit.why: Crediting a nonexistent mechanic for the lane lead misleads the reader about what's actually driving it.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real driver, sustained Mantra-Q poke uptime.

audit.why: Lulu is female; a stray pronoun reads as a wrong-champion leak.

audit.whatIsWrong: packet.defects flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere on the page — no 'wait for X seconds before you Y' line exists despite the matchup being framed around Whimsy's cooldown.
audit.why: Whimsy (W) has a flat 18s cooldown and Wild Growth (R) is 120/100/80s — both are concrete numbers a player can play around, and neither appeared anywhere.
audit.corrected: Added the 18s Whimsy figure to loading and breakdown.cooldowns, and the R's 120/100/80s to breakdown.cooldowns.

edits.before: - Karma vs Lulu - Track: Lulu Whimsy (Polymorph). - Track his engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - Whimsy (Polymorph) spent means windows open. - Keep the ult for the swing moment.
edits.after: - Karma vs Lulu - Track: Lulu Whimsy (Polymorph). - Track her engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - Whimsy is 18s — spent means an 18s window opens. - Keep the ult for the swing moment.

edits.after: - Lulu's Whimsy (W) is an 18s-cooldown polymorph that deletes a carry's kit mid-fight — bait it before the real engage. - Your RE shield-speed answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Her R Wild Growth is 120/100/80s — save yours for the same swing moment.

edits.before: Late Karma enables: RE the engage, tether the diver, RQ the sieges.
edits.after: Her Whimsy polymorph and Wild Growth out-scale you as a single-target peeler for a fed carry, so the late game tips to Lulu.
